fnol_text: My name is Ines Osei and I live at 489 Sycamore Court, Greenville, SC 29646. You can reach me on (555) 796-8052 or ines.osei@example.com. On 23 October 2024 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Amara Mbeki, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00034. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Osei on (555) 796-8052 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 23 October 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Owen Laurent gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Amara Mbeki reports lacerations to the forearm and attended County General. Ines reports whiplash.
